status: DRAFT 20 V SWITCHER-DIRECT DESK BUDGET; DRAFT desk screen of an unvalidated draft board. Nothing is measured; values come from routed geometry and datasheet-maximum desk models and do not establish ratings, temperatures or qualification.

continuous.source: manufacturing/pd20-status.md, fixed decision "OSC current contract": continuous 1.7 / 1.6 / 0.3 A, all rails at once
continuous.model_limit: Steady-state desk evaluation at the continuous contract current.

transient_20ms.source: manufacturing/pd20-status.md, fixed decision "OSC current contract": 20 ms transient 2.0 / 1.9 / 0.4 A
transient_20ms.model_limit: Steady-state desk evaluation held at the 20 ms transient current. It is not a transient model: a 20 ms event is far shorter than the board and part thermal time constants, so the copper and junction temperatures shown overstate one event; no hold-up, slope or limiter timing is covered.

let_through_max.source: manufacturing/pd20-status.md, fixed decision "OSC current contract": let-through maximum 2.1 / 2.0 / 0.5 A including tolerance
let_through_max.model_limit: Steady-state desk evaluation held at the let-through maximum (the case earlier records call the limiter maximum). The limiter trips; it does not regulate current, so this level is a bound, not an operating point. Let-through is not simulated or measured.

legacy_pd15_budget.source: LEGACY: the PD15 Board B output budget (CLAUDE.md), which phase 30-33 B20 reports mislabelled "rated". It is not a PD20 contract case and not a B20 rating
legacy_pd15_budget.model_limit: Kept only so earlier phase records can be compared; no PD20 acceptance reads it.

rating_status: No B20 rating exists. The contract cases are OSC demand levels evaluated by a desk model; the legacy case is comparison only.
switcher_path: VIN (PD 20 V contract, 19 V desk input) feeds three switchers directly: +12 V buck U1, +5 V buck U2 and the -12 V inverting stage U3. Each stage passes a post filter, a shunt (RSH1-RSH3) and its rail FETs to J6/J7 and the J10/J11 bus headers.
loss_basis: thermal-check.py desk model: conduction, switching, gate and quiescent IC terms plus diode, inductor, post-filter, shunt and rail-FET losses, with mean board rise from the board area and an assumed convection coefficient range. Not a thermal simulation or measurement.

native_input_binding.scope: Native input and calculation freshness only; not current, thermal or electrical qualification

open_qualification: Full-load, low-line, thermal and transient behavior (OPEN: no hardware).
The -12 V stage carries the largest desk loss and junction estimate; its copper temperature is UNKNOWN.
Input current against the PD contract during startup (OPEN).
